title: Admin enablement kit for RBAC v2: SSO onboarding, audit queries, and support macros
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: Provide a single admin enablement artifact for RBAC v2 that combines quick onboarding steps for tenant admins, SAML/SSO configuration checks, curated audit-log queries for investigations, and plug-and-play support macros for Tier 1/2. This ticket delivers a deployable document + runbook snippets to be added to the Admin docs site and the Support handbook.
acceptance_criteria: Admin enablement doc published to Confluence with step-by-step SSO and RBAC v2 setup
Runbook excerpt added to oncall playbook and verified in a fire-drill (post-mortem exercise)
At least five support macros committed to the Support handbook and tested by a support engineer
Audit log query templates validated against production logs (Splunk/Datadog) and saved to audit_queries.sql
Security review signed off and release tag added to rbac-2.0 docs
steps: Draft Admin guide: overview, role model, least-privilege examples, and migration checklist for existing tenants
Add SSO/SAML onboarding section: IdP prerequisites, metadata exchange, attribute mappings (email -> principal), and common IdP gotchas
Curate audit log queries for common investigations: role grants, permission changes, failed SSO logins, and admin console access
Write support macros for common admin support flows (role reassign, SSO failure triage, audit export requests)
Run a tabletop with Support and Oncall: simulate a tenant-reported broken SSO flow and a suspicious admin role grant
Incorporate feedback, file a security review, and publish to Confluence + link from Support handbook
support_macros:
[RBAC-ROLE-REASSIGN]
Title: RBAC role reassign request
Steps:
 1) Confirm requester identity and authorization (support checklist)
 2) Ask for tenant ID, user email, desired role, and justification
 3) Run audit query 'ROLE_CHANGES' and attach results
 4) If eligible, perform role change in Admin Console and paste action ID
 5) Notify customer and log in ticket
Escalation: If change touches org-admin or system roles, escalate to Security (sec-oncall)

[SSO-LOGIN-FAIL]
Title: SSO login failure troubleshooting
Template:
 1) Confirm IdP used and timestamp of failure
 2) Ask for full SAML response if customer can provide, otherwise request IdP logs
 3) Run quick health checks: IdP metadata validity, SP certificate expiration, entityID match, and clock skew check
 4) Query internal auth logs: 'SELECT * FROM auth_logs WHERE tenant_id=? AND event IN (''saml_failure'',''sso_error'') ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50'
 5) If error indicates mapping_mismatch or missing_attribute, provide mapping fix instructions; escalate to SSO eng if cryptographic or 500 errors occur

[AUDIT-EXPORT-REQ]
Title: Audit export for legal/compliance requests
Template:
 1) Verify requestor identity and legal basis
 2) Run saved query 'audit_export_default' with tenant filter and date range
 3) Store results in encrypted S3 bucket and record link in ticket
 4) Notify Legal and Compliance with export metadata
 5) Mark ticket with label 'compliance-export' and follow retention rules
runbook_excerpt:
Runbook: Suspicious role grant detected via alert
1) Detection: Alert rule 'role_grant_high_priv' fired in SIEM with granter_email and grantee_email
2) Initial triage: Run audit query 'ROLE_CHANGES' filtered by grantee and time window +/- 2h to capture context
3) Quick mitigation: If grant is active and unauthorized, temporarily revoke the role and create a restricted read-only override for the affected user
4) Communication: Notify tenant admin via recorded channel and open a dedicated incident thread in #security-incidents
5) Post-incident: Export full audit trail, perform root-cause analysis, and schedule a follow-up with the customer

Runbook: SSO service outage affecting multiple tenants
1) Detection: Increased SSO error rate in Auth Dashboard (>5% baseline)
2) Triage: Verify IdP certificate expiry and metadata validity across affected tenants
3) Mitigation: If change is from our side (SP cert rotation), roll back to previous cert using emergency-rollback playbook; otherwise, open joint ticket with IdP vendor and apply tenant-level bypass (temporary password provisioning) only with approval
4) Post-incident: Add monitoring for the specific failure mode and document the timeline
audit_queries: ROLE_CHANGES: SELECT ts, actor_email, target_email, old_role, new_role, reason, action_id FROM audit_logs WHERE action = 'role_change' AND ts BETWEEN ? AND ? AND tenant_id = ? ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 500
SSO_FAILURES: SELECT ts, tenant_id, user_email, error_code, saml_status, relay_state, raw_response_snippet FROM auth_logs WHERE event = 'saml_failure' AND ts >= ? ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 200
ADMIN_CONSOLE_ACCESS: SELECT ts, user_email, ip_address, user_agent, action FROM audit_logs WHERE resource LIKE 'admin_console%' AND ts BETWEEN ? AND ? AND tenant_id = ? ORDER BY ts DESC
